process() returns error when config language is unknown

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "ts_pack.h"

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"nonexistent_xyz\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("x = 1", config_handle);
    if (result != 0) { return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    ts_pack_process_config_free(config_handle);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
